headline: CCS-specific frameworks in Asia-Pacific 'largely absent'
summary: gasworld's write-up of the OGCI / Global CCS Institute Asia-Pacific report (briefed 13 Aug) underscores that CCS-specific legal and regulatory frameworks across most APAC jurisdictions remain largely absent, a gap the report says must close to unlock regional storage.
co2crc_note: Reinforces Australia's regulatory head-start (offshore GHG storage permits) versus APAC neighbours still lacking CCS frameworks — relevant to CO2CRC's regional partnering and storage-hub positioning.
extractor_note: Radar re-coverage of the OGCI/GCCSI Asia-Pacific report already briefed on 2026-08-13; gasworld page egress-blocked, date confirmed from Google Alerts feed metadata.

headline: Startup turns captured CO₂ into a consumer soft drink
summary: Heatmap News profiles a venture using captured CO₂ as the carbonation in a branded soft drink — a small but media-friendly example of CO₂ utilisation and a marketing route for carbon-removal storytelling.
co2crc_note: Peripheral CO₂-utilisation novelty; limited direct relevance to CO2CRC's storage/MMV focus but a useful public-engagement narrative data point.
